messages.text: Can you turn this surprised cat pic into a classic meme? Top text WHEN YOU THINK ITS FRIDAY, square, bottom text BUT ITS ONLY MONDAY

Can you turn this surprised cat pic into a classic meme? I’ve been having one of those weeks where I keep losing track of what day it is. For the top text, use WHEN YOU THINK IT'S FRIDAY, and keep the image square. The bottom text should be BUT IT'S ONLY MONDAY. Make the lettering big, uppercase, and white with black outlines, and don’t let it cover the cat’s eyes. Keep the apostrophes but leave out full stops in the actual meme text; the free-tier image size is fine.

style.prompt: Turn this photo into a classic meme. Keep the photo and the cat exactly as they are. Add two lines of text in big bold uppercase Impact-style font, white letters with thick black outlines, centered. Top text, placed in the very top strip of the image above the cat's ears, well clear of the cat's eyes: "WHEN YOU THINK IT'S FRIDAY". Bottom text, placed along the bottom edge of the image: "BUT IT'S ONLY MONDAY". Spell the text exactly as written, with the apostrophes and no full stops or other punctuation. Do not put any text over the cat's eyes or face. No other text.
